# near-dup-detector

> Detect near-duplicate documents with process-stable MinHash and LSH banding plus 64-bit SimHash, verified candidate pairs and deterministic clusters Python package `trysac-near-dup-detector`, import name `near_dup_detector`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
